name: Vortex Graph DB
tagline: High-speed in-memory graph compute engine for autonomous agent swarms.
description: Agent knowledge graphs require microsecond traversal and live relationship mutation without disk IO bottlenecks. Vortex provides an in-memory lock-free graph store with sub-millisecond BFS traversals.

name: Chronos Realtime
tagline: Deterministic low-latency state sync engine for collaborative venture tools.
description: Distributed collaborative state synchronization often suffers from race conditions and split-brain states under spotty network connections. Chronos implements a CRDT-based deterministic state journal with sub-10ms peer sync.
